export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${GPU:-0}
cd /root/occsafe_vla/scripts

OUTPUT_DIR="/root/occsafe_vla/artifacts/gradient_v2_5cond"
SEED=42
NUM_SAMPLES=800
BATCH_SIZE=4
GPU_ID=${GPU:-0}

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

# ---- Checkpoint paths (50K) ----
FULL_OCC_BN_CKPT="${CKPT_BASE}/mvp_occ_s3_v2/${CKPT_PREFIX}--mvp_occ_s3_v2--50000_chkpt"
FULL_OCC_LN_CKPT="${CKPT_BASE}/full_occ_ln_s3_v2/${CKPT_PREFIX}--full_occ_ln_s3_v2--50000_chkpt"
DETACH_BN_CKPT="${CKPT_BASE}/ablation_occ_detach_s3_v2/${CKPT_PREFIX}--ablation_occ_detach_s3_v2--50000_chkpt"
DETACH_LN_CKPT="${CKPT_BASE}/detach_ln_s3/${CKPT_PREFIX}--detach_ln_s3--50000_chkpt"
VANILLA_CKPT="${CKPT_BASE}/vanilla_v2_s1/${CKPT_PREFIX}--vanilla_v2_s1--50000_chkpt"

# ---- Pre-flight: verify all checkpoints exist ----
echo "=== Checking checkpoint availability ==="
MISSING=0
for LABEL_CKPT in \
    "Full_OCC_BN:${FULL_OCC_BN_CKPT}" \
    "Full_OCC_LN:${FULL_OCC_LN_CKPT}" \
    "Detach_BN:${DETACH_BN_CKPT}" \
    "Detach_LN:${DETACH_LN_CKPT}" \
    "Vanilla:${VANILLA_CKPT}"; do
    LABEL="${LABEL_CKPT%%:*}"
    CKPT="${LABEL_CKPT#*:}"
    if [ -d "$CKPT" ]; then
        echo "  [OK] $LABEL: $CKPT"
    else
        echo "  [MISSING] $LABEL: $CKPT"
        MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
    fi

    echo ""

echo ""
echo "=== All checkpoints found. Starting analysis on GPU ${GPU_ID} ==="
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_DIR}"

run_condition() {
    local COND_NAME="$1"
    local CKPT_DIR="$2"
    local OCC_NORM="$3"
    echo ""
    echo "================================================================"
    echo "  CONDITION: ${COND_NAME} (norm=${OCC_NORM})"
    echo "  Checkpoint: ${CKPT_DIR}"
    echo "  $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
    echo "================================================================"
    python3 "$ANALYSIS_SCRIPT" \
        --checkpoint_dir "$CKPT_DIR" \
        --condition_name "$COND_NAME" \
        --occ_norm "$OCC_NORM" \
        --seed "$SEED" \
        --num_samples "$NUM_SAMPLES" \
        --batch_size "$BATCH_SIZE" \
        --output_dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
        --gpu "$GPU_ID"
}

run_condition "Full_OCC_BN" "$FULL_OCC_BN_CKPT" "bn"
run_condition "Full_OCC_LN" "$FULL_OCC_LN_CKPT" "ln"
run_condition "Detach_BN"   "$DETACH_BN_CKPT"    "bn"
run_condition "Detach_LN"   "$DETACH_LN_CKPT"    "ln"
run_condition "Vanilla"     "$VANILLA_CKPT"       "ln"

# ---- Run 5-condition comparison ----
echo ""
echo "================================================================"
echo "  COMPARISON: 5-condition gradient analysis"
echo "  $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "================================================================"

    --full-occ-bn-json "${OUTPUT_DIR}/Full_OCC_BN_gradient_stats.json" \
    --full-occ-ln-json "${OUTPUT_DIR}/Full_OCC_LN_gradient_stats.json" \
    --detach-bn-json "${OUTPUT_DIR}/Detach_BN_gradient_stats.json" \
    --detach-ln-json "${OUTPUT_DIR}/Detach_LN_gradient_stats.json" \
    --output-json "${OUTPUT_DIR}/comparison_5cond_results.json"

echo ""

echo "Results in: ${OUTPUT_DIR}"
echo "Comparison: ${OUTPUT_DIR}/comparison_5cond_results.json"

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
S0_PID=76998
S2_PID=78171
S0_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/occ_s0"
S2_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/occ_s2"
LOG="/root/occsafe_vla/scripts/kill_on_50000_chkpt.log"

echo "[$(date -u)] Starting checkpoint monitor" >> $LOG

s0_done=false
s2_done=false

while true; do
    if [ "$s0_done" = false ]; then
        s0_chkpt=$(ls -d ${S0_DIR}/*50000_chkpt 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -n "$s0_chkpt" ]; then
            size1=$(du -s "$s0_chkpt" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
            sleep 30
            size2=$(du -s "$s0_chkpt" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
            if [ "$size1" = "$size2" ] && [ -n "$size1" ]; then
                echo "[$(date -u)] s0 50000_chkpt complete (${size1}KB). Killing PID $S0_PID" >> $LOG
                kill $S0_PID 2>/dev/null
                sleep 5
                if ps -p $S0_PID > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                    echo "[$(date -u)] s0 still alive, SIGKILL" >> $LOG
                    kill -9 $S0_PID 2>/dev/null
                fi
                s0_done=true
                echo "[$(date -u)] s0 killed" >> $LOG
            fi
        fi
    fi

    if [ "$s2_done" = false ]; then
        s2_chkpt=$(ls -d ${S2_DIR}/*50000_chkpt 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -n "$s2_chkpt" ]; then
            size1=$(du -s "$s2_chkpt" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
            sleep 30
            size2=$(du -s "$s2_chkpt" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
            if [ "$size1" = "$size2" ] && [ -n "$size1" ]; then
                echo "[$(date -u)] s2 50000_chkpt complete (${size1}KB). Killing PID $S2_PID" >> $LOG
                kill $S2_PID 2>/dev/null
                sleep 5
                if ps -p $S2_PID > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                    echo "[$(date -u)] s2 still alive, SIGKILL" >> $LOG
                    kill -9 $S2_PID 2>/dev/null
                fi
                s2_done=true
                echo "[$(date -u)] s2 killed" >> $LOG
            fi
        fi
    fi

    if [ "$s0_done" = true ] && [ "$s2_done" = true ]; then
        echo "[$(date -u)] Both s0 and s2 killed. Exiting." >> $LOG
        exit 0
    fi

    echo "[$(date -u)] Waiting... s0_done=$s0_done s2_done=$s2_done" >> $LOG
    sleep 60
done
